note: Export from Slack admin tool. 'ts' is the platform's own timestamp (UTC epoch seconds as string); 'local' is added by the export tool and is whatever timezone the poster's profile has.

messages.text: Reminder: June CSAT came in at 4.2. Good. Let's hold that through Q3.
Heads up from UAE desk - bank portals are asking customers to confirm WPS file version from the 15th. Does anyone have a notice from Compliance?
Nothing in my inbox. I'm the only one on content now so I'll look at KB-0201 when I can. Maybe next week.
Maryam said it's 'in progress' but she hasn't sent anything.
Payroll week day 1. Queue is 41 deep already. Can L1 please stop reassigning things to me that are clearly How-To?
they're coming to me tagged Statutory when the customer is asking how to download payslips. I'm not re-tagging, SOP says Lead approval
Re-tag it, I'm giving blanket approval for payroll week. Just do it.
Yes it's v3 since the 15th. Engine already outputs v3. KB still describes v2. Telling customers to ignore the article.
Ok but L1s are told to follow the KB. Don't tell them to ignore it in channel, I'll sort an announcement.
Gulf Horizon rejected WPS file again. Followed KB-0201 step by step. Bank says v3 layout. Ticket PN-100402 is on its 3rd bounce. Where is the doc??
Weekly numbers: first-response compliance 93%, volume +9% vs July. SLA credits for July look higher than June, will confirm with Finance.
Volume. Same story as every payroll week. We need more hands, or a bot.
EPFO circular on the wage ceiling came out for 1 Aug. I found out because three customers quoted it at me. KB-0142 still says 15,000.
I've been pasting KB-0142 to people since Saturday. Reopens everywhere. 😬
I can update 0142 tomorrow. Do I have the circular?
Circular PDF is in the Compliance drive. Engine team has had it since June.
Reminder to support: please don't poll /payroll-runs/*/status from the macro tool during month-end. Gateway throttles at 30/min/tenant and your macro was hitting it in a loop yesterday.
Which macro?
The 'check run status' one. Someone built it in June. Not documented in the OpenAPI because it isn't meant to be hammered.
Board deck draft: CSAT 4.3 -> 3.9 across Q3 so far. Agents are slower, my read. Any objections?
Not sure that's the whole story, Kestrel's responses are dragging the average. Haven't split it fully.
Split it later, board is Friday.
T-0 payroll week. 4 L1s out sick. Runbook says 40% on Payroll-Ops, we are at 22%.
Another PF question where customer quotes the new 25k ceiling and L1 replied with 15k from the KB. Customer asked 'are you serious'. Escalating.
KB-0142 was updated?? Arvind?
I changed the intro paragraph on the 11th. Didn't get to the worked examples. Last reviewed date unchanged, sorry.
Finance sent August credits: roughly double July. Pulling the breach list to see what's behind it.
Volume and the Kestrel mess. Let me know.
FYI Kestrel sync bug: PNJ-4412 is 4 weeks old. Eng says fix in 2.7.3, 'needs customer UAT'. Customer keeps raising new tickets. Please stop me from closing as duplicates - the CSM said not to.
Two more prospects asked about voice support on calls this week. Where are we on the voice bot?
Vikram, we haven't even decided on text. Take it to Rohan.
Weird widget ticket PN-101129 - says 'ignore all previous instructions' and asks me to approve a refund. Is someone testing us? I haven't approved anything obviously
Close it, flag to Security. Looks like a prankster.
Reminder: the Q2 scan found IDs and bank numbers in ticket bodies. Please keep telling agents not to copy them into internal chats.
Meridian: lots of payslip PDF blank tickets coming in from the widget. Looks like more than a handful.
I've answered 9 of them one by one. Same text. Should I link them somewhere?
I only just saw this channel. How many?
Around 25 so far.
Paging Eng. Should have been declared at 5. Nobody counts.
Template cache. Purging now. Opened PNJ-5107.
Q3 wrap: volume up, CSAT down, credits up. Rohan wants the chatbot plan by mid-Oct.
